verdict.rationale: Publishing a machine-readable API spec is a fair question for an API-first inference cloud, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, and probes of the common OpenAPI/Swagger paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, /api/openapi.json, /.well-known/openapi.json) all returned 404, so there is no evidence of a downloadable spec from DeepInfra. Being OpenAI-compatible implies OpenAI's own spec might partly apply, but DeepInfra does not document or publish one.
